services.desc: One of Keystone’s newest additions is our pair of private event rooms - flexible spaces for 50 or up to 300 guests. Both rooms include professional presentation amenities so your gathering runs smoothly from setup to send-off. The museum hosts corporate events, lectures, weddings, concerts, workshops, receptions, and more - all with the character of 130,000 square feet of restored trucks, tractors, and Americana nearby. Both rooms offer catering by our own Keystone Grill. Build the right menu for your group - coffee and hors d’oeuvres, a full buffet, or something in between.
